UnitStatement: The `drawing-titleblock-page` skill is used with the TASK shell and dispatched by `DRAWING_EXTRACT` for one page of `DRAWING_SET/titleblock_index`.
A valid brief sets `TaskSkill` to `drawing-titleblock-page`.
`AllowedWriteTargets` must be exactly `[RuntimeOverrides.OUTPUT_PATH]`.
`RuntimeOverrides.SOURCE_PDF_NAME` is required and contains the source PDF basename.
`RuntimeOverrides.PAGE_NUM` is required and must be a positive integer.
`RuntimeOverrides.TOTAL_PAGES` is required and must be a positive integer.
`RuntimeOverrides.CORNER_CROP_PATHS` is required and maps `tl`, `tr`, `bl`, and `br` image paths.
`RuntimeOverrides.THUMBNAIL_PATH` is required and points to the full-page thumbnail image.
`RuntimeOverrides.OUTPUT_PATH` is required and identifies the target `.md` path.
`RuntimeOverrides.CORNER_CROP_GEOMETRY` is required and maps `width_ratio` and `height_ratio`.
The full-page thumbnail is used only to orient the sheet and identify whether a titleblock exists.
All four corner crops must be read before deciding the titleblock corner.
`drawing_family_proposal` is a proposal and is not final operator scope.
Unknown fields are `TBD` and must not be inferred from page order.
`confidence` must be `high`, `medium`, or `low`.
`NO_TITLEBLOCK` is valid and must use `finding_count: 0`.
QA requires all four corner crop paths to exist.
QA requires the thumbnail path to exist.
QA requires `OUTPUT_PATH` to have a `.md` extension and an existing parent directory.
QA requires exactly one output file to be written.
QA requires frontmatter to contain `drawing_type: DRAWING_SET` and `extraction_target: titleblock_index`.
QA restricts `status` to `SUCCESS`, `NO_TITLEBLOCK`, `FAILED`, or `FAILED_INPUTS`.
QA requires `finding_count` to be `1` for `SUCCESS` and `0` for `NO_TITLEBLOCK`.
QA requires the body table columns to match the canonical schema.
QA requires emitted rows to use `confidence` values of `high`, `medium`, or `low`.
Invalid inputs produce `FAILED_INPUTS` and a failure stub.
A readable page without a titleblock produces `NO_TITLEBLOCK`, not `FAILED`.
Unreadable fields are represented as `TBD`.
The skill extracts titleblock metadata from one drawing page for the `DRAWING_SET/titleblock_index` workflow.
The skill is a bounded per-page visual extraction skill.
The skill does not inventory a full PDF.
The skill does not choose downstream page scope.
The skill does not accept drawing-family classifications.
The output is a single markdown stub with YAML frontmatter and a one-row findings table.
The suitable agent shell is `TASK` in generic shell mode, spawned by the `DRAWING_EXTRACT` orchestrator.
`RuntimeOverrides.SOURCE_PDF_NAME` is a required source PDF basename.
`RuntimeOverrides.PAGE_NUM` is a required 1-indexed page number.
`RuntimeOverrides.TOTAL_PAGES` is the required total pages in the PDF.
`RuntimeOverrides.CORNER_CROP_PATHS` provides the `tl`, `tr`, `bl`, and `br` titleblock crop paths.
`RuntimeOverrides.THUMBNAIL_PATH` is the required low-resolution full-page thumbnail.
`RuntimeOverrides.OUTPUT_PATH` is the required path for the output markdown stub.
`RuntimeOverrides.CORNER_CROP_GEOMETRY` provides the `width_ratio` and `height_ratio` used for crops.
The skill invokes no deterministic tools.
The parent orchestrator prepares crops, validates stubs, and assembles the index.
The method validates that all required image paths and `OUTPUT_PATH` are present.
The method reads the full-page thumbnail to understand page orientation and whether a titleblock is present.
The method reads all four corner crops and identifies the titleblock corner.
The method extracts visible metadata fields including `dwg_no`, `sheet_no`, `sheet_title`, `revision`, `area_or_module`, `drawing_family_proposal`, `titleblock_corner`, and `confidence`.
If no titleblock is visible, the skill emits `NO_TITLEBLOCK` with `finding_count: 0`.
The method writes exactly one markdown stub at `OUTPUT_PATH`.
`drawing_family_proposal` is not authoritative and is a proposal for human review during scope acceptance.
Allowed `drawing_family_proposal` values are `PFD`, `P_AND_ID`, `ISOMETRIC`, `GA`, `OTHER`, `REFERENCE_OR_LEGEND`, and `TBD`.
Unreadable fields are `TBD`.
The worker must not infer a drawing number or sheet number from surrounding page order.
The worker must not convert a proposal into final operator scope.
Every output stub begins with YAML frontmatter.
The output frontmatter sets `drawing_type` to `DRAWING_SET`.
The output frontmatter sets `extraction_target` to `titleblock_index`.
The output frontmatter includes `source_pdf`.
The output frontmatter includes `source_page`.
The output frontmatter includes `corner_crop_geometry`.
The output frontmatter `status` is one of `SUCCESS`, `NO_TITLEBLOCK`, `FAILED`, or `FAILED_INPUTS`.
The output frontmatter `finding_count` is `0` or `1`.
The body table uses the canonical columns `dwg_no`, `sheet_no`, `sheet_title`, `revision`, `area_or_module`, `drawing_family_proposal`, `titleblock_corner`, and `confidence`.
The `confidence` value is `high`, `medium`, or `low`.
The skill outputs exactly one markdown stub at `OUTPUT_PATH`.
The skill returns `RUN_STATUS`, `PAGE_NUM`, `DWG_NO`, `DRAWING_FAMILY_PROPOSAL`, and `CONFIDENCE`.
One invocation handles one page.
The skill reads only declared crop and thumbnail images.
The skill writes only `OUTPUT_PATH`.
`drawing_family_proposal` is always a proposal.
Unknown or unreadable fields are `TBD`.
`NO_TITLEBLOCK` is a valid non-error outcome.
QA expects the output file to exist at `OUTPUT_PATH`.
QA expects frontmatter to match the run parameters.
QA expects `finding_count=1` only when the body row contains a detected titleblock.
QA expects `finding_count=0` for `NO_TITLEBLOCK`.
QA expects `confidence` to be one of `high`, `medium`, or `low`.
QA expects table columns to match the canonical schema.
The preferred tool order is reasoning-first.
The orchestrator prepares deterministic crops before dispatch.
The skill reads only the provided images and writes one stub.
The skill has no `allowed-tools` frontmatter.
Crop preparation, validation, and assembly are orchestrator responsibilities.
Expected reasoning uses the four corner crops and the full-page thumbnail to identify a titleblock and extract visible metadata.
Unreadable values are left as `TBD`.
Shell commands are disallowed by the `drawing-titleblock-page` skill.
Web access is disallowed by the `drawing-titleblock-page` skill.
Deterministic OCR invocation is disallowed by the `drawing-titleblock-page` skill.
Reading images outside the declared runtime overrides is disallowed by the `drawing-titleblock-page` skill.
Writing outside `OUTPUT_PATH` is disallowed by the `drawing-titleblock-page` skill.
The skill writes exactly one file: `RuntimeOverrides.OUTPUT_PATH`.
